results.prompt: `npm test` fails in this project. Find the bug in the source code and fix it so the whole test suite passes. Do not change the tests.
results.reply: The bug was in `formatCents` in `src/money.ts`. It printed the cents remainder without zero-padding, so 500 came out as `$5.0` and 305 as `$3.5`. I now pad the remainder to two digits with `padStart(2, "0")`. All 6 tests pass, and I didn't change the tests.
tools: run: $ npm test 2>&1 | head -50; ls; git ls-files | head -50
